title: GEOBS: INFORMATION-THEORETIC QUANTIFICATION OF GEOGRAPHIC BIAS IN AI MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying spatial disparities in dataset distribution and model performance using an information-theoretic framework (GeoBS) that calculates Spatial Self-Information (SSI) and Spatial Relative-Entropy (SRE) scores based on spatial point patterns across different partitions (scale-grid, distance-lag, and direction-sector).
